# Stress Unregistered Scopes

## 4. Requirements

### SEC-SEC-821 — Security scope without scope-map row

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Type | security |
| Target | v2.3.0 |
| Status | planned |
| Priority | high |
| Risk | high |
| Stability | stable |

#### Requirement

The stress fixture must report registered requirement types whose scope prefix is absent.

#### Rationale

New scope documents must not appear silently outside the Scope Map.

#### Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Unregistered scope diagnostics are emitted.
